fields.description: Enable controlled Sales Invoice creation from real estate sales installments.

fields.description: If enabled, generated Sales Invoices may be submitted through normal ERPNext validation. Keep disabled unless accounting setup is ready.
fields.label: Auto Submit Sales Invoice

fields.description: Allow multiple installment rows to be grouped into one Sales Invoice.
fields.label: Allow Grouped Installment Invoice

fields.description: Default non-stock service item used on Sales Invoices generated from installments.

fields.description: Require the Unit accounting dimension to be present when generating Sales Invoice items.
fields.label: Require Unit Dimension

fields.description: Automatically refresh installment invoice and payment status from linked Sales Invoices and Payment Entries.
fields.label: Auto Update Installment Status

fields.description: Number of grace days after due date before an unpaid installment is considered overdue.
fields.label: Overdue Grace Days

fields.description: Allow partial payment allocation against installment Sales Invoices.
fields.label: Allow Partial Collection

fields.description: Prevent creating a second active Sales Invoice for the same installment row.
fields.label: Block Duplicate Invoice For Installment

fields.description: Require Customer on Sales Contract before creating Sales Invoice.
fields.label: Require Customer On Contract

fields.description: Require Unit on generated Sales Invoice Item rows.
fields.label: Require Unit On Invoice Item

fields.description: Use Company default currency when Sales Contract currency is blank.
